quote: the generation of accurate and coherent text within images, such as complex road signs, product labels, or blackboards, remains a major unsolved problem .
The primary objective of our benchmark is to rigorously evaluate the capability of text-to-image generation models to render accurate and coherent text embedded within synthetic images.
tasks: Other: Text-to-Image Generation with Embedded Text
Other:Text-to-image generation with embedded text rendering
outputs: images containing embedded text generated from natural language prompts

quote: To quantify the performance of models in rendering text, we employ an OCR-based verification framework.

We utilize the Tesseract OCR engine for extracting text from generated images... we evaluate OCR performance using a suite of metrics: character-level accuracy (Character Error Rate, CER), word-level accuracy (Word Error Rate, WER), normalized edit distance (NED), and sequence similarity using Python package difflib.

We evaluate the quality of the rendered text by comparing the OCR output to the ground truth using similarity metrics, including normalized edit distance (NED), character error rate (CER), and word error rate (WER).
